subScenes.name: 聚会结束道别
subScenes.description: 聚会结束，朋友提议离开并礼貌告别。

qaPairs.triggerText: It was great seeing you tonight!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 聚会结束，朋友主动表达愉快感受，期待用户回应告别

followUps.text: Same here! Let’s do this again next month.
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！咱们下个月再聚一次吧。

followUps.text: Absolutely! I’m swamped this week, but let’s catch up soon.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！这周我太忙了，但咱们尽快再联系。

followUps.text: I’m going to miss this vibe—thanks for such a fun night!
followUps.text_cn: 我会想念这种氛围的——谢谢你带来这么愉快的夜晚！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友聚会结束时，回应对方的正面告别语，体现自然社交互动

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友主动表示要离开，用户需回应告别

followUps.text: Already? I was just getting comfortable!
followUps.text_cn: 这么快？我正玩得开心呢！

followUps.text: Got it—safe drive home!
followUps.text_cn: 明白，路上小心！

followUps.text: Me too—I’ll walk you out.
followUps.text_cn: 我也是，我送你到门口。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应朋友表示要离开的常见方式，语气可轻松、关心或略带不舍

qaPairs.triggerText: Thanks for coming—you made the night special.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 谢谢你来参加，你让这个夜晚特别难忘。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 主人或朋友表达感谢，用户需礼貌回应告别

followUps.text: Aww, thank you—I had the best time!
followUps.text_cn: 哎呀，谢谢你！我玩得超开心！

followUps.text: No problem—I’ll bring snacks next time!
followUps.text_cn: 别客气！下次我带小吃来！

followUps.text: Really? I’m just glad I could be here.
followUps.text_cn: 真的吗？我只是很高兴能来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方表达感谢时，用户需自然回应，避免冷淡或敷衍，体现社交情商

subScenes.name: 表达感谢
subScenes.description: 主人感谢客人到场，客人回应感激之情。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thanks so much for helping me out today!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 谢谢你今天帮了我这么多！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事表达感谢后，你如何自然道别并回应

followUps.text: Anytime! Let’s grab coffee soon.
followUps.text_cn: 随时效劳！咱们改天喝杯咖啡吧。

followUps.text: Don’t mention it — you’d do the same for me.
followUps.text_cn: 别客气，换作你也会帮我。

followUps.text: Really glad I could help. Have a great one!
followUps.text_cn: 很高兴能帮上忙，祝你今天愉快！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事在你提供帮助后表达感谢时的自然回应，语气应温暖、真诚，避免冷淡或过度正式。

qaPairs.triggerText: I really appreciate your support this week.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真的很感谢你这周的支持。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在项目结束后表达感谢，你如何回应并结束对话

followUps.text: It was a team effort — you were key to the win!
followUps.text_cn: 这是团队合作的结果，你才是关键功臣！

followUps.text: Thanks for saying that — I’m just glad things worked out.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你这么说，我只是很高兴事情顺利解决了。

followUps.text: Anytime! Let me know if you need help next week.
followUps.text_cn: 随时找我！下周如果需要帮忙尽管说。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场同事间正式但非刻板的感谢回应，体现专业性与人情味的平衡。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thanks for walking me home last night!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因关心行为表达感谢，你如何回应并自然结束道别

followUps.text: Of course! I’m just glad you got home safe.
followUps.text_cn: 当然应该的！我只希望你平安到家。

followUps.text: Hey, next time it’s my turn to walk you home!
followUps.text_cn: 嘿，下次轮到我需要你送我回家啦！

followUps.text: No problem at all — you’re always welcome to call me if you’re out late.
followUps.text_cn: 完全没问题，以后你晚上在外晚了随时给我打电话。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于亲密朋友间因日常关怀行为产生的感谢，回应需体现情感温度与自然口语节奏。

subScenes.name: 约定再聚
subScenes.description: 双方提议下次见面时间，达成共识。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事在道别时提议下次见面，学习者需要回应

followUps.text: Absolutely! How about next weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 当然！下周六怎么样？

followUps.text: I'd love to, but my schedule's packed this month. Let me check next week?
followUps.text_cn: 我很想，但这个月排满了，我下周确认一下？

followUps.text: Deal! Text me when you're free.
followUps.text_cn: 一言为定！你有空了发我消息。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事间自然道别时回应再聚提议，语气轻松但真实

qaPairs.triggerText: We should grab coffee next time!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在下班时提议下次非正式见面，学习者需回应

followUps.text: Sounds perfect—I’ve been craving a good latte!
followUps.text_cn: 太棒了！我正想喝杯好拿铁呢！

followUps.text: I’m not really a coffee person, but maybe tea or lunch instead?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太喝咖啡，不如改喝茶或者一起吃午饭？

followUps.text: Haha, sure—if I don’t get transferred to another office first!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，好啊——如果我没被调到别的办公室的话！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场朋友间轻松提议，回应需体现个性与真实生活状态

qaPairs.triggerText: Let’s not let too much time pass before we meet up again.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 咱们别隔太久再见面了啊！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 老朋友在告别时表达情感联结，学习者需回应情感+行动

followUps.text: No way—I’m already planning our next hike!
followUps.text_cn: 绝不可能！我正计划咱们下一次徒步呢！

followUps.text: You're right—I’ve missed hanging out. Let’s do it next month.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我确实想和你聚了，咱们下个月见吧。

followUps.text: I know… life’s been crazy. I’ll reach out when things calm down.
followUps.text_cn: 我知道……最近太忙了，等我这边缓下来就联系你。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于情感较深的社交关系，回应需平衡真诚与现实性

subScenes.name: 温馨告别语
subScenes.description: 使用温暖语句结束对话，如‘保重’‘路上小心’。

qaPairs.triggerText: I should head out now, but it was great catching up!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我该走了，不过今天聊得太开心了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事在聚会结束时温馨告别，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Same here! Let’s do this again soon!
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！我们尽快再约吧！

followUps.text: Take care! I’ve got an early meeting tomorrow, so I’ll catch you later.
followUps.text_cn: 保重！我明天早会，咱们改天再聊。

followUps.text: You too! Don’t forget to send me those photos you mentioned!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！别忘了把之前说的那些照片发给我哦！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事在非正式场合结束交谈时的自然告别场景，回应需体现情感温度与个人态度

qaPairs.triggerText: Well, I’ve got to run—thanks for hanging out!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在下班后道别，你如何得体回应？

followUps.text: No problem! Drive safe and have a good weekend!
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！开车小心，周末愉快！

followUps.text: Same! Let me know if you need help with the project next week.
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！如果下周需要项目帮忙，记得告诉我！

followUps.text: Yeah, totally! Catch you on Monday!
followUps.text_cn: 对啊！周一见！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场同事间下班或午休后的轻松告别，语气自然、略带温度但不冗长

qaPairs.triggerText: I’m gonna head off—this was such a nice chat!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我要走了，这真是一次愉快的聊天！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在咖啡馆或公园道别，你如何温暖回应？

followUps.text: It really was! Let’s plan a walk next time—maybe by the lake?
followUps.text_cn: 真的太棒了！下次我们约个散步吧？比如去湖边？

followUps.text: I’m so glad we got to talk. I’ve missed this!
followUps.text_cn: 很高兴我们能聊上，我真的很想念这种时光！

followUps.text: You too! Text me if you’re free this week—I’ve got a new podcast to share!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！这周有空就给我发消息，我有个新播客想推荐给你！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于非正式社交场合中朋友间的情感性告别，回应需体现真诚与个人化

subScenes.name: 挥手道别
subScenes.description: 离开时挥手致意，伴随微笑和简短告别语。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事在离开时挥手道别

followUps.text: Yeah, take care!
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，保重！

followUps.text: Wait, can we grab coffee tomorrow?
followUps.text_cn: 等等，我们明天一起喝咖啡吗？

followUps.text: Got to run—talk soon!
followUps.text_cn: 我得走了，回头聊！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事在工作/社交场合挥手告别时的自然回应，语气轻松真实

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或朋友在结束聚会或下班时告知即将离开

followUps.text: Same here—have a good one!
followUps.text_cn: 我也是，祝你愉快！

followUps.text: Already? I was hoping we could chat more.
followUps.text_cn: 这么快？我还想多聊聊呢。

followUps.text: Drive safe!
followUps.text_cn: 开车小心！

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应他人告知离开时的常见反应，体现社交敏感度和情境适配

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或朋友在结束一天互动时约定次日再见

followUps.text: Definitely, see you then!
followUps.text_cn: 一定，明天见！

followUps.text: Hope so—I’ve got a meeting then.
followUps.text_cn: 希望吧，我那天有个会议。

followUps.text: Better make it Friday—I’m swamped tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 不如改到周五吧，明天我太忙了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应未来重逢约定时的三种典型态度：确认、犹豫、调整，符合真实社交动态
